items.title: 68097_Freddie Green oral history interview
items.q: Herschel was helpful and nice with you, was he, when you joined the band? ... Yeah. When -- you see Hershel wanted -- he wanted everything to be just right.

ctx.x: Nobody said anything. (laugh) As I can remember now. And, the next thing I remember -- I don't know whether anybody came over and told me that it was okay, or what -- but, I think Basie said it sounded good, you know. And, I think Herschel probably said something -- something like that, -- I don't know.
